Sample.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/6] Based on non-directive supportive psychotherapy (Brent et al., 1997), the goals of this condition were to establish and maintain rapport, provide support, and help participants identify and express feelings; this group did not cover any specific skills from the other conditions.
